author: k. r. stuart
title: Eastern Illinois softball extends win streak to 12 with doubleheader sweep over Bradley
text:
Eastern Illinois University announced on March 25 that its softball team extended its winning streak to 12 games after sweeping a doubleheader against Bradley at Williams Field.
The Panthers secured a 5-3 victory in the first game and followed up with an 8-5 win in the second, moving their season record above .500. The announcement marks continued success for the team as they maintain momentum during their current stretch of games.
No additional details or individual performances were provided, but a complete recap is expected to follow according to the university’s release.
The ongoing win streak highlights a strong period for Eastern Illinois softball, suggesting positive developments for the remainder of their season.
